_note: Elite (النخبة), landscape 3080x1993. Two columns: real_name + facebook_name on the left, username + bank_number on the right, each in a dashed-edge dark bar below its baked-in label.
_measured: Rows come from the bright dashed borders -- count bright/dark transitions per row and the bar's top and bottom edges spike: 645/841 and 1146/1342, so the centres are 742 and 1242. Columns come from each bar graphic's left-right symmetry axis (the x that best mirrors the bar onto itself), which is immune to the uneven background: 934 and 2190. Cross-correlating the left bar against the right half independently gives the same 1256px spacing. Note the columns are NOT mirrored about the card's centre line -- assuming that puts the right column ~70px too far left.
fill_note: Dark bars, so glyphs are a white->light-grey gradient with a thin dark outline.
